attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Restructures core Liquid service registration into a new feature-gated module and moves filter registrations (sanitize_html, resource_url, append_version, supported_cultures) behind RequireFeatures on Resources/Html/Localization, so templates depending on those filters could silently break if those specific features aren't enabled where previously they were always registered via AddLiquidViews."}

reason: Restructures core Liquid service registration into a new feature-gated module and moves filter registrations (sanitize_html, resource_url, append_version, supported_cultures) behind RequireFeatures on Resources/Html/Localization, so templates depending on those filters could silently break if those specific features aren't enabled where previously they were always registered via AddLiquidViews.
